status: Locally timestamped specification recorded before downloading or inspecting the external price panel. Not an independently registered preregistration, prospective experiment, or statistically independent sample.
external_universe: Eight US-listed iShares country equity ETFs: Australia, Canada, Germany, Hong Kong, Japan, Switzerland, France and United Kingdom. Fixed geographical spread among long-established developed-market funds; no outcome-based additions or removals.
alignment: All requested assets required; finite positive adjusted closes on the supplied trading-date panel; no imputation, ticker replacement or post-result universe changes.
fractional_model: Unchanged refined_fractional.py rolling_refinement, including all earlier benchmarks and ablations; original grids, windows and horizon-aware selection.
additional_forecaster: Exactly 0.5 times persistent_asymmetric variance plus 0.5 times gjr_garch variance at every origin/asset/horizon. No learned or retrospectively selected weights. Optional forecast ensemble, not a new fractional variance recurrence.
figarch: arch 7.2.0 ZeroMean, Normal, FIGARCH(1,d,1), power 2, truncation 1000; standardized centered returns using the common origin-fitted mean and scale. Fit on preceding 1008 returns at original refits; default initial estimates, SLSQP maxiter1000 ftol1e-9. Preserve fitting backcast while updating with observed residuals between refits. Report finite nonconverged fits; abort nonfinite results; no substitution.
evaluation: Same complete 1/5/21-session targets, every 5 observed sessions on grid starting at price position252; from 2023-01-01; minimum21 sessions between refits. Refit at25-session intervals on this grid. Primary normalized QLIKE, secondary normalized squared error. Annual and per-asset summaries retained.
comparison: Standalone fractional and fixed ensemble against all references; paired circular block bootstrap 2000 replicates, seed1729, blocks5/10 origins, whole asset vectors resampled together. Nominal intervals, no multiplicity-adjusted significance claims.
development_analysis: Append the same fixed ensemble and FIGARCH to the recorded US index/sector forecasts. These remain exploratory reused-history results, reported separately from external-universe replication.
stopping_rule: One external evaluation of this fixed specification; report all results regardless of sign. No retuning from external losses. Any subsequently necessary bug fix must be disclosed separately; never silently rewrite this record.
limitations: Country ETFs share trading hours, currency and global shocks with US assets. Historical prices are retrospectively adjusted, not point-in-time. Universe selection is deliberate, not random. External results are not a prospective trading test.
